overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong cross-platform presence centered on academic research, computational social science, and disinformation studies. With a combined audience of 3,580 followers across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon, engagement is high, driven by major announcements such as new research publications, grant awards, software releases (CooRnet v2.0), and recruitment posts.

contentThemes.description: Sharing new papers, grant awards, and conference presentations regarding coordinated inauthentic behavior and information operations.
Updates on computational tools like CooRnet for detecting coordinated link sharing behavior.
Recruitment posts for postdocs and PhD students in computational social science.

recommendations: Cross-promote tool releases and grant announcements across all platforms, ensuring call-to-actions are customized per network.
Capitalize on Bluesky's high amplification (repost) rate by sharing digestible summaries and threads of new research papers.
Increase post frequency on Mastodon with methodological discussion prompts to foster community interaction.

platformInsights.bluesky: Highest overall engagement rate (6.14% avg), with strong resharing/repost activity particularly around research opportunities and paper launches.
platformInsights.mastodon: Niche, highly focused academic audience showing steady interest in tool releases and methodology discussions.
platformInsights.linkedin: Largest follower base (1,850) delivering high absolute engagement on major professional milestones like grants and recruitment posts.
